lines.text: Many learners say: I have a good news.
News has no a. Say good news.
Good news! I have good news for you.

data.why: News has no a. Say good news.

native.tip: news 是不可数名词，不能加 a，也不加 s。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I have a good news.”？😅 news 是不可数名词，前面不加 a：“I have good news.”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: News is uncountable, so do not use a before it.
en.caption: Do you say “I have a good news.”? 😅 News is uncountable, so it takes no a: “I have good news.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
